mapper.sql: select c.config_id, c.post_id, c.employee_category, c.data_scope_strategy, c.contract_type_mode, c.default_contract_type, c.social_type_mode, c.default_social_type, c.probation_period_mode, c.default_probation_period, c.job_grade, case when c.account_enabled = '1' then true else false end account_enabled_bool, c.status, c.version, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from hr_onboarding_position_config c
mapper.insert: insert into hr_onboarding_position_config ( post_id, employee_category, data_scope_strategy, contract_type_mode, default_contract_type, social_type_mode, default_social_type, probation_period_mode, default_probation_period, job_grade, account_enabled, status, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark ) values ( #{postId}, #{employeeCategory}, #{dataScopeStrategy}, #{contractTypeMode}, #{defaultContractType}, #{socialTypeMode}, #{defaultSocialType}, #{probationPeriodMode}, #{defaultProbationPeriod}, #{jobGrade}, '1''0', #{status}, #{version}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update hr_onboarding_position_config set post_id = #{postId}, employee_category = #{employeeCategory}, data_scope_strategy = #{dataScopeStrategy}, contract_type_mode = #{contractTypeMode}, default_contract_type = #{defaultContractType}, social_type_mode = #{socialTypeMode}, default_social_type = #{defaultSocialType}, probation_period_mode = #{probationPeriodMode}, default_probation_period = #{defaultProbationPeriod}, job_grade = #{jobGrade}, account_enabled = '1''0', status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark}, version = version + 1 where config_id = #{configId} and version = #{version}
mapper.select: select role_id from hr_onboarding_position_config_role where config_id = #{configId} order by role_id
mapper.insert: insert into hr_onboarding_position_config_role (config_id, role_id, create_by, create_time) values (#{configId}, #{roleId}, #{operator}, sysdate())
